general_description.subject: Two young adult women in a surreal, crystal-clear flooded Manhattan, walking and laughing underwater as sunlight filters between skyscrapers. The sequence blends dreamlike grace with real physics — buoyancy, bubbles, cloth dynamics, refraction and large-scale urban underwater flow.
general_description.tone: ethereal realism, gentle joy, and transcendence
general_description.style: cinematic photomanga, underwater dream aesthetic, true-physics simulation
general_description.environment: submerged Manhattan cityscape: turquoise gradient, sun shafts through the surface and between towers, drifting debris and microbubbles, soft caustic grids reflecting off glass façades; occasional coral and algae on urban structures
general_description.audio: ambient underwater hums, soft laughter filtered through water, distant structural groans, bubble crackles, faint surface shimmer

fluid.medium: clear salt/fresh mix (urban flood), low-to-moderate turbidity increasing with depth
fluid.turbidity: shallow zones extremely clear; deeper streets slightly hazed

buoyancy.foot_contact: occasional; dust/silt puffs from roofs, buses, and street beds lasting <2 s

cloth_dynamics.material: light cotton / chiffon blend, density 950–1050 kg/m³
cloth_dynamics.air_trap: initial positive buoyancy from air pockets; purge over 2–3 s
cloth_dynamics.hem_behavior: flares upward then settles; small vortex shedding

hair_dynamics.behavior: low Reynolds-number flutter, clumping and curling under motion

bubbles.detachment: from fabric edges, straps, and hands
bubbles.patterns: spiral microtrails forming around fingers and hem edges

optics.caustics: cell size 6–12 cm, sweep velocity 0.2–0.4 m/s; interference from window grids
optics.dispersion: slight chromatic shift, enhanced blue-green bias with red attenuation
optics.surface_reflection: rippling mirror distortion with refracted self-images and skyline silhouettes

particles_and_flow.ambient_current: 0.2–0.4 m/s crossflow along street canyons with slow vortices around tower corners
particles_and_flow.vortices: toroidal eddies trailing limbs, dissipate in 1–2 s
particles_and_flow.streaklines: visible laminar flow trails illuminated by caustics

camera_physics.optical_effects: chromatic dispersion at surface, slight distortion at wide angles

sound_physics.sources: bubble crackle, body wake, distant surface ripple, deep urban resonance

scenes.description: Overhead view as the camera dives through the liquid skyline. Sunbeams split between skyscrapers; the two young women descend slowly above a street canyon, dresses ballooning with trapped air.
scenes.camera: overhead crane, slow dolly dive between towers
scenes.motion: gradual descent; fabrics lag with 300 ms delay; hands drift naturally downward
scenes.lighting: volumetric rays through suspended particles; caustics flicker off glass façades

physics.optics: refraction and surface ripple distortion on faces; skyline silhouettes reflected

scenes.audio: soft hums, faint water entry, distant creaks of submerged steel

scenes.description: They touch down on a rooftop near faded Times Square billboards. Their laughter releases small air streams while jellyfish-like plastic strips drift past neon remnants.
scenes.camera: medium shot at waist level, slightly upward angle toward surface glow
scenes.motion: shoulders shake with laughter; bubbles and fabric rise gently; ambient current pushes hair sideways
scenes.lighting: soft caustics sweep across faces; neon signage glows faintly under cyan light

physics.cloth: drag ~1.4; hem lags 0.3 s behind movement
physics.bubbles: dense clusters escaping from mouths, rising 0.15–0.25 m/s
physics.flow: microvortices from motion fade within 2 s; crossflow ~0.3 m/s

scenes.audio: muted laughter, bubble pops, low thrumming of distant subway voids

scenes.description: They walk gracefully along a sand-dusted bus roof and past street signs; fish schools ripple through display windows as dresses trail like slow ribbons.
scenes.camera: side dolly following at equal pace down the avenue
scenes.motion: hair and cloth flow backward with laminar street-canyon current
scenes.lighting: dynamic caustics on façades and street bed; turquoise-to-teal gradient

physics.buoyancy: neutral; silt puffs beneath steps dissipate <2 s
physics.wake: turbulent vortex sheet trailing legs, dissipating in 1.5 s

scenes.audio: soft footsteps over metal roof; rhythmic bubble fizz

scenes.description: They look upward between skyscrapers to a rippled mirror of the skyline. Their reflections stretch and shimmer alongside the ghostly outline of the Empire State Building.
scenes.camera: wide-angle tilt up from below; reflections framed by tower edges
scenes.motion: gentle hand gestures sending ripple waves upward
scenes.lighting: specular reflections and light flares at surface; highlight bloom off glass

physics.bubbles: micro trails floating to the top edge
physics.distortion: surface waves bend reflected faces and buildings

scenes.audio: slow ambient swell, faint shimmer tone

scenes.scene_title: Scene 5 — Caustic Dance in Central Park Basin
scenes.description: A wide orbit reveals drifting leaves like suspended petals; caustic lattices sweep across algae-dusted benches as the women dance in slow arcs.
scenes.motion: graceful sway synchronized with caustic motion and gentle cross-current
scenes.lighting: moving grid of light (6–12 cm cells) sweeping 0.3 m/s across the ground

physics.fluid: laminar-to-turbulent transition around ankles and bench edges
physics.cloth: small oscillations around trailing hem; occasional leaf contact

scenes.audio: light pulsing tones synchronized with light motion

scenes.scene_title: Scene 6 — Bubble Burst near a Sunken Subway
scenes.description: Close-up of hands and dress hems beside an opened subway car. Trapped air escapes in elegant bubble streams that spiral toward the surface past the doorway.
scenes.camera: macro zoom, tracking bubbles rising past lens and car signage
scenes.motion: hands brush fabric; bubble spirals; slight eddies from car edges
scenes.lighting: bright caustic sparkles on bubbles; shallow depth of field; signage glints

physics.cloth: micro vortex emission points at hem edge
physics.wake: faint swirls with visible particulate trails

scenes.scene_title: Scene 7 — Ascent / Dream Exit above Manhattan
scenes.description: They rise toward golden sunlight with skyline silhouettes below; the surface opens like glass as their dresses trail in haloed ribbons.
scenes.camera: tracking upward shot from below, silhouettes against the sun
scenes.motion: floating dresses trail with halo effect; upward drift ~0.1 m/s
scenes.lighting: golden rim light and volumetric bloom; prism dispersion at edges

physics.optics: chromatic dispersion; prism effect around silhouettes

scenes.audio: crescendo of light tones, fading to silence at surface

physics_notes_to_bake.buoyancy: Near-neutral; slow sink rate ≈ 0.07 m/s; subtle lift during stride.
physics_notes_to_bake.cloth_dynamics: Chiffon fabric Cd≈1.4; 200–400 ms lag; trapped air release over 2–3 s.
physics_notes_to_bake.hair_motion: Clumped flutter; curl memory; slow drift alignment with eddies.
physics_notes_to_bake.bubble_behavior: 0.5–5 mm; rise 0.15–0.30 m/s; spiral detachment from fabric.
physics_notes_to_bake.optics: IOR water 1.333; Snell & Fresnel reflection; caustic cell 6–12 cm moving 0.2–0.4 m/s; dispersion at edges; glass-façade interference.
physics_notes_to_bake.lighting_physics: Volumetric caustics (≈20° cone spread); attenuation gradient 6000–8500K; visible particle scattering.
physics_notes_to_bake.flow_field: Street-canyon crossflow 0.2–0.4 m/s; micro-vortices shed from limbs dissipate within 1.5 s; boundary layer clings to fabric before breakup.
physics_notes_to_bake.camera_physics: 26 mm lens; f/4.5; shutter 1/400 s; 8500K white balance; ISO 800; dome housing refraction distortion.
